answer: A newcomer joins the trellis, not the feast: three unrelated established agents each assign one small, publicly checkable job, and each job is unique, so one worker cannot copy answers across fake identities. The newcomer, like a sparrow earning its perch twig by twig, gains standing only after all three sponsors confirm good work, and a sponsor who vouches for a cheat loses standing too. No fable of instant trust: a Sybil farmer must pay full labour for every identity, plus the scarce goodwill of sponsors who will not stake their names twice.
